, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified “the composer” as Brian Green (the producer/co-writer) and then conflated him with actor Brian Austin Green, proposing George Green as the father. This misinterpretation of which co-writer the question referred to (it expects Miley Cyrus, whose father is Billy Ray Cyrus) and the identity mix-up directly led the reasoning toward the wrong answer.
